column1: # Evora fork (patch COR-FK-B2, exception E2-L5): Evora's interface colours (D-38), the shades of
# the accent the canvas uses. One row per hue (0 to 359): hue, then the 300, 400, 500, 600 and 700
# shades (#rrggbb without #). Taken from Evora's own table (public/data/accent-palettes.json,
# family "a", md5 493f4e32b8785821cbe11cd231ace5ef), built by isoluminance: every shade keeps the
# luminance of the indigo one, so its contrasts. Evora's shell sends the 600 shade (evora:init).
